title: The Missing Coefficients: Bayesian Pairwise Merging for Model Personalization
abstract: arXiv:2609.39055v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: How can we personalize a shared expert library from a user's pairwise choices? Prior work can realize different reward trade-offs by merging reward-specialized experts, given a vector of trade-off weights. In practice, users can more naturally choose between outputs than specify numerical weights. The challenge is therefore to turn these choices into the coefficients required for merging, while accounting for ambiguity when feedback is limited. Our key idea is to treat the unknown reward weights as latent variables: infer a posterior over them from pairwise choices and reward-score differences, and use its mean directly as the merge coefficients. We instantiate this idea as Bayesian Pairwise Merging (BPM), whose posterior also characterizes which reward trade-offs remain plausible given the feedback. We evaluate BPM on radiology summarization, image captioning, and story generation, spanning text-to-text and image-to-text generation. Wit

translated_title: 缺失的系数：用于模型个性化的贝叶斯成对合并
translated_abstract: 我们如何根据用户的成对选择来个性化一个共享的专家库？先前的工作在给定权衡权重向量的条件下，可以通过合并奖励专精的专家模型来实现不同的奖励权衡。但在实践中，用户在两个输出之间做出选择比指定数值权重更加自然。因此，挑战在于如何将这些选择转化为合并所需的系数，同时在反馈有限的情况下处理歧义性。我们的核心思想是将未知的奖励权重视为潜变量：从成对选择和奖励分数差异中推断出它们的后验分布，并将其均值直接用作合并系数。我们将这一思想实例化为贝叶斯成对合并，其后验分布还能刻画在给定反馈下哪些奖励权衡仍然是合理的。我们在放射学摘要、图像描述和故事生成任务上评估了BPM，涵盖文本到文本和图像到文本的生成任务。（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出贝叶斯成对合并，将用户难以给出的数值权重转化为潜变量，通过成对选择和奖励分数差异推断后验分布，并以均值作为专家模型合并系数，从而在反馈有限时实现无需用户指定权重的模型个性化。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes Bayesian Pairwise Merging (BPM), which treats unknown reward weights as latent variables, infers their posterior from pairwise choices and reward-score differences, and uses the mean as merge coefficients, enabling model personalization without requiring users to specify numerical weights.
